title: Piper nigrum essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Piper nigrum essential oil is a volatile oil extracted from the dried berries of the black pepper plant, *Piper nigrum*, through steam distillation. This essential oil is known for its pungent, spicy aroma and contains compounds like piperylene and limonene. In herbalism, it is used to support digestive health by stimulating the secretion of digestive enzymes and alleviating bloating and gas. It is also applied topically to relieve muscle pain and inflammation due to its warming and analgesic properties. Piper nigrum essential oil is valued for its ability to enhance circulation and its potential antimicrobial effects.
